key_insight: MMIR-TCM combines tongue image segmentation, multimodal language understanding, and retrieval-augmented generation to support more structured and evidence-grounded TCM clinical decisions.
clinical_relevance: The framework aims to improve the consistency and reproducibility of TCM tongue-based diagnosis and prescription support, where subjective interpretation is a major challenge.
method: Training-free Memory-SAM for robust tongue extraction from images.
Fine-tuned Qwen3-VL to generate structured tongue diagnosis outputs.
Qwen3-based RAG to produce evidence-grounded clinical decision support.
evidence_signal: The paper introduces MedTCM, a new large-scale multimodal dataset, and TDEU, a domain-specific evaluation metric designed to better measure clinical accuracy than standard metrics.
watch_item: Performance gains depend on new dataset quality, retrieval reliability, and careful clinical validation before real-world use.
paper_title: MMIR-TCM: Memory-Integrated Multimodal Inference and Retrieval for TCM Clinical Decision Support
